meta.name: add-telegram
meta.description: Add Telegram channel integration via Chat SDK.

copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想给应用增加聊天消息渠道
copy.tagline_en: Add Telegram chat to your existing app
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to add a chat channel to your app.

howto.what: 为项目添加 Telegram 频道支持：复制并注册 Telegram 适配器，安装依赖，运行构建与测试，引导创建机器人并完成配对，使服务能通过 Telegram 收发消息。
howto.when: 当用户要求将 Telegram 接入项目，如添加 Telegram 频道、机器人或集成时触发。

say.text: 请为项目添加 Telegram 频道支持。
say.note: 开始复制适配器并安装依赖。

say.text: 运行配对步骤，把当前聊天绑定到 Telegram。
say.note: 生成四位配对码，发送给机器人后完成。

say.text: 重启服务以加载 Telegram 适配器。
say.note: 重启后 Telegram 机器人开始轮询消息。

howto.what_en: Adds Telegram channel support to the project: copies and registers the Telegram adapter, installs dependencies, runs build and tests, guides bot creation and pairing, enabling the service to send/receive messages via Telegram.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user asks to add Telegram to the project, e.g., add a Telegram channel, bot, or integration.

say_en.text: Add Telegram channel support to the project.
say_en.note: Starts copying the adapter and installing dependencies.

say_en.text: Run the pairing step to bind this chat to Telegram.
say_en.note: A 4-digit code is generated; send it to the bot to complete.

say_en.text: Restart the service to load the Telegram adapter.
say_en.note: After restart, the bot polls Telegram for messages.
